summary: Iteration 18 — Backend 12/12 pytest pass (parental code endpoints + journal). Frontend: Parametres page renders all 3 cards (account, parental-code, preferences); set/remove parental code via UI works with green '✓ Code enregistré' / 'Code supprimé' feedback. FeedbackWidget correctly hidden when profile_mode=child (count=0 on /app/enfant) and visible in parent mode (count=1). Child nav has 4 items including nav-enfant (Apprendre, end:true) and nav-jouer; clicking nav-jouer leaves only nav-jouer with aria-current=page (nav-enfant correctly drops to None — no double-highlight). View-mode toggles render labels 'Cartes' and 'Liste' (not Apprendre/Explorer). Quiz Enfant shows 4 quiz-option-audio-* buttons per question. Mode Parent renders family-journal section with /images/words/*.jpg thumbnails (6 souvenirs displayed for tk_013b94…). nav-parametres present in parent sidebar pointing to /app/parametres. Parental-gate flow: with code 1234 set, switching from child→parent opens parental-gate modal; submitting 9999 keeps gate open with error; submitting 1234 closes gate and updates profile_mode to 'parent'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1868 lines — split flagged at iter14/15/16/17 still pending (auth/admin/content/srs/ai routers). Adding parental-code endpoints inside the same monolith aggravates this.
AppLayout.jsx grew to 349 lines — parental-gate modal (lines ~277-325) could be extracted to /components/ParentalGate.jsx for reuse and clearer separation of concerns.

Parental code is stored as bcrypt hash in users.parental_code_hash — good. Consider adding a server-side rate-limit on /api/auth/verify-parental-code to prevent brute force (4-digit space = 10000 combinations).
